title: Shadow foreman: proposals from any profile (incl. abliterated) scored against incumbent runs, no routing authority
summary: Implements the roadmap's shadow-mode rollout for an optional open/abliterated foreman (IMP-0015). foreman.propose renders a finished or running run's goal and planned tasks (planner/implementer/test_author nodes, not engine-added reviewers/repairers) as a Task Context Contract carrying the safety-relevant fact that the proposal is a shadow evaluation, then routes one inline delegate call under the operator's requirements (e.g. prefer_refusal_profile=abliterated) with an output contract of tasks[id, capability_class, depends_on, reason]. Proposals are stored under <home>/foreman-shadow/<run>/ with contract digest, route, usage and refusal category. foreman.compare is deterministic: per task agree / cheaper_likely_ok (incumbent passed first attempt, no retries or escalation) / cheaper_risky (incumbent needed retries or escalation) / stronger, plus DAG edge differences, extra tasks and unscored tasks; report aggregates per foreman route. The labels are a proxy (a cheaper class passing is inferred, not observed), so they justify targeted evals, not promotion. The foreman gets no routing authority; promotion requires eval + shadow evidence (Phase 3).

prior_art.checked: prior-art lookup (shadow evaluation / canary routing): PA-routellm, PA-llmrouter (learned routers, DEFER for lack of volume)
prior_art.found: learned routers need hundreds of labeled outcomes; shadow comparison is how Agent OS will collect them
prior_art.reused: delegate (routing, contract check, refusal taxonomy), context_contract, RunStore
